notes: The canonical Ubuntu 24.04 definition and its catalog/source fields remain unchanged. Select this additional Debian 13 profile explicitly.
Build tools are host prerequisites, not installed through a hidden package-manager transaction. Exact observed versions are recorded in qualification evidence.
The source package includes the complete locked original archive. The binary package is separately installed with source state unavailable.
Bounded tests are not a numerical reference oracle, official performance result, OCI deployment or hardware qualification.

Only the serial src-mpi build with DO_MPI=OFF is covered. MPI and OpenMP configurations are not qualified by this profile.
